name: unified-agent-sdk
description: TypeScript SDK workspace for Unified Agent: @unified-agent/protocol, @unified-agent/client and @unified-agent/approval-client

scripts.build: npm run build -w @unified-agent/protocol && npm run build -w @unified-agent/client && npm run build -w @unified-agent/approval-client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @unified-agent/protocol && npm run test -w @unified-agent/protocol && npm run test -w @unified-agent/client && npm run build -w @unified-agent/client && npm run test -w @unified-agent/approval-client
scripts.test:conformance: npm run build -w @unified-agent/protocol && npm run test:conformance -w @unified-agent/client
scripts.test:conformance:live: npm run build -w @unified-agent/protocol && npm run test:conformance:live -w @unified-agent/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @unified-agent/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @unified-agent/client && npm run build -w @unified-agent/client && npm run typecheck -w @unified-agent/approval-client
